dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular, high-contrast light-colored loops ('O' shapes) and arcs ('C' shapes) with serrated or pixelated boundaries; high gradient from the dark base coat to the light interior ring structure.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Concentrated clusters of high-intensity pixels found at the intersections and vertices of linear structures, lacking internal gradients within the core of the cluster.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Geometric alignment of the three most prominent dorsal ring centroids forming an irregular scalene triangle.
